description: Shared Renovate preset for the Railway template repos. See README.md.

dockerfile.description: Base images are pinned through `# renovate:` ARGs instead. The built-in manager would report them twice.

customManagers.description: Version pins marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above an ARG or a YAML key
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) packageName=(?<packageName>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)(?: depType=(?<depType>\S+))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>\S+))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>\S+))?\s+(?:ARG \w+=|\w+: )(?<currentValue>[^@\s]+)(?:@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}))?

packageRules.description: Name updates after the component, for example "Bump OpenCode to 2.0.29"
Docker registries don't report when a tag was pushed, so image updates can't wait out a release age
Merge compatible updates once CI passes
A 0.x minor update can break compatibility, so it waits for review
A PostgreSQL major upgrade needs a dump and restore of every database
Template repos call the shared workflows on main
